interpretation: Default CPU runner reported n_threads=2 despite 12 available logical CPUs and no Docker CPU quota; requesting 4 or 10 threads did not improve the same 3-topic fixture and timed out.

Intel Iris Xe was initially dropped by Ollama until OLLAMA_IGPU_ENABLE=1; after enabled, Ollama confirmed 29/29 layers on Vulkan GPU. The 3-topic sample remained about the same latency as warm CPU, and the 24-topic fixture still timed out.
Reducing num_ctx from 32768 to 8192 reduced Vulkan KV cache from 896 MiB to 224 MiB but did not make the 24-topic fixture complete within 60 seconds.

The strongest verified bottleneck is decode time and variable output length on this local model/hardware. num_predict=-1 supplies no output bound; the timed-out non-streaming calls cannot report their final generated token count. No safe finite output cap is established by the schema or quality evidence.
decision: No CPU/GPU option is adopted. All candidate probes remain unapproved and do not change preflight or the production manifest.
